note: Releases of the generation parameters (packs, thresholds, repair table). A release is made by a person after reading an evaluation report; every release cites the report that asked for it (tools/generation/evaluate.py check). Nothing changes inside a session.

releases.summary: First release: the packs built from the dataset profiles and the thresholds of the specification, checked on a simulated batch of 240 requests (0 fallbacks); the proposals in the report are for the next release.
releases.review: made by the implementer for the owner to read; not yet reviewed

releases.summary: Adds the joint model of laboratory results (content/generation/packs/joint.json, a Gaussian copula over 19 analytes with 92 correlated pairs, fitted offline by tools/generation/fit_joint.py) so a panel keeps the correlations real patients show instead of independent draws. The thresholds are those of R1. The simulated batch of 240 requests was run again with it: the report and its outcomes are unchanged (0 fallbacks), so the cited report is the one that shows generation behaving with the new packs; the case for the change is tools/ci/test_generation_joint.py (the correlation error of drawn panels is less than half that of independent draws, every value is inside its zone, 200-seed property tests pass).
